name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ExposedRoot.dead_level_invisible
title: A slot with an all-zero level j is invisible after j: its columns vanish in every reachable row at every level i > j
statement: If each element of P (i+1) has the form u0 * N0 i + u1 * N1 i with u0, u1 in P i, and N0 j = N1 j = 0, then every element of P i is 0 for every i > j.
